topics.title: llama-server goes voice: /tts and realtime transcription
topics.why: Merged Tue Oct 20 evening CT. POST /tts for TTS models with streaming and speaker-reference upload (PR #26603, b11781), plus an OpenAI-compatible /v1/realtime websocket transcription API (PR #30636, b11780), tested with Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime GGUF. Local speech in and out from one server.

topics.title: SpaceX Q3: $14.58B revenue, Tesla merger committees
topics.why: Revenue up 161% vs $12.72B expected, net income $4.4B, AI business up ninefold (mostly renting compute). Q1 2027 guide $33-37B. Musk says both boards formed special committees to discuss a Tesla merger.

topics.title: Starship Flight 15 will try to catch both booster and ship
topics.why: Musk on the Q3 call: Flight 15 expected next month, first-ever ship catch attempt. Shotwell expects the FAA license to cover tower catch for both stages. Unofficial planning date NET Nov 8.

topics.title: Ornith-1.5-122B: MIT open-weight MoE with official GGUF and MLX
topics.why: Qwen3.5-MoE architecture, so stock llama.cpp. Official Q4_K_M is 75.8GB (Q8_0 132.6GB), so on a 32GB card it is a GPU+RAM split. MLX 4/8-bit, FP8, NVFP4 also posted.
